Owen and Jack are in the same class. Owen wants to visit Toronto. After school, we play together. For example, let's ride our bikes around the lake this afternoon.
Owen's favorite season is winter. The airport is big and clean. The train station is my favorite place. A double room faces the courtyard.
I am happy every day. I like my life very much. Jack likes salad too.
